# Robert Bedsted

Robert Bedsted is identified as a patient representative ("Patientrepræsentant") serving on the steering committee of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation ("Atrieflimren i Danmark") [^src1][^src2]. He is named in the steering committee listings of two consecutive annual reports, covering the periods reported in the 2023 and 2024 editions of the AFDK annual report [^src1][^src2].

The 2023 report's steering committee listing appears within chapters 5–7, which describe the database's data foundation, including patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the committee's composition, alongside epidemiological data on atrial fibrillation incidence across Denmark's five regions [^src1]. The 2024 report's listing appears in a section (pages 66–70) that documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education, describes how Hospitalsenhed Midt has run systematic patient education since 2012, and presents the steering committee membership together with key methodological limitations of the database, underscoring AFDK's role as a nationwide quality database under the Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and approved by Sundhedsstyrelsen [^src2].

Beyond his listed role as patient representative on the steering committee, no further biographical or relational details about Robert Bedsted are present in the corpus. This is a thin page: the entity is documented through two brief steering-committee mentions, with no additional relationships, claims, or timeline events recorded.
